level_description: Linear Semantic Dependencies (Flat schemas with multi-step arithmetic cascades, proportional tariffs/taxes, and linear forward references)

L2_logistics_invoice.name: Freight Logistics Billing & Tariff Cascade
L2_logistics_invoice.description: Calculates base shipping costs from weight and rate, applies tiered fuel surcharges and customs duties, and sums the total freight invoice.

prompts.system: You are an automated logistics orchestration agent generating billing records for international freight shipments. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a freight billing invoice for a bulk cargo shipment. Select realistic dimensions and calculate all dependent costs exactly.

unit_rate_per_kg.description: Standard shipping cost per kilogram in USD

L2_payroll_stub.name: Employee Payroll & Statutory Deductions
L2_payroll_stub.description: Calculates gross compensation from hourly metrics, applies proportional tax withholdings and retirement deductions, and resolves exact net take-home pay.

prompts.system: You are an enterprise payroll processor generating bi-weekly employee pay stubs. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate an itemized payroll stub for an hourly contractor. Determine hours, calculate gross pay, withhold statutory deductions, and emit net pay.

hours_worked.description: Total billable hours worked in pay period

hourly_rate.description: Contract hourly billing rate in USD

L2_retail_order_billing.name: E-Commerce Checkout & Sales Tax Computation
L2_retail_order_billing.description: Calculates subtotal from integer item quantities, deducts promotion allowances, computes regional sales tax, and determines the final charged balance.

prompts.system: You are an e-commerce checkout backend generating final customer transaction receipts. Output ONLY raw, valid JSON.
prompts.user: Generate a purchase order receipt. Select item units and base pricing, apply promotional discounts, calculate regional sales tax, and provide final charge.
